content.description:
Drivetrain is on a mission to empower businesses to make better decisions. Our financial planning & decision-making platform helps companies scale and achieve their targets predictably.

Drivetrain is a remote-first company headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2021 by a couple of ex-Googlers, Drivetrain is a fast-growing company on a trajectory for success with backing from leading venture capital firms.

Drivetrain provides a great culture for its employees to thrive in and be happy.

💜 Remote-friendly: Drivetrain brings together the best and the brightest, no matter where they are and provides them a great degree of autonomy. We trust our people.
🗣️ Open & transparent: We know that when our creators have access to all the information they need, their best work will emerge.
👏 Idea-friendly: We provide an environment to explore new ideas, to take risks, to make mistakes, and to learn, so you can succeed. Anyone in the company can come up with great ideas and become a catalyst for positive change. We let the best ideas win.
👥 Customer-centric: We follow a product-led growth strategy, continuously learning from our customers and collaborating to build the amazing software that Drivetrain is.

About Drivetrain
Drivetrain is an AI-native FP&A platform for finance teams that have outgrown spreadsheets and legacy planning tools. CFOs, VPs of Finance and FP&A teams use it to run budgets, forecasts, headcount plans and scenarios, with AI agents doing much of the modeling, reporting and budget-vs-actuals work.
We sit on some of the most sensitive data a company has: its financials, payroll and plans. We pull it in through 800+ connectors to ERPs, CRMs and HRIS systems like NetSuite, Salesforce and ADP, and we expose it, permission-controlled, inside tools like Claude and ChatGPT through MCP and a Slack bot. Customers can host in the US (us-east1) or the EU (Frankfurt).
Trust is part of the product. We already hold SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, are GDPR compliant, and commit that customer data never trains any AI model. Drivetrain is backed by Elevation Capital, Jungle Ventures and Venture Highway (Series A).
The role
You will be the single owner of security at Drivetrain: product, cloud, corporate, compliance and AI. This is not a ticket-closing role. You set the strategy, make the risk calls, own the roadmap and budget, and are the person enterprise CFOs and their security teams talk to when they decide whether to trust us with their numbers.
The role sits one step below a formal CISO title. You will run the charter end to end and represent security to leadership and the board. As the company and the function scale, this is the natural path to CISO.
Three things make this harder and more interesting than a typical SaaS security lead role:
Financial data at the core. Payroll, compensation and P&L data from hundreds of connected systems, with SOC 1 controls that auditors and customer finance teams rely on.
AI in the loop. Agents that read and act on customer data, frontier model providers under zero-retention terms, and an MCP surface that brings Drivetrain data into third-party AI tools. Securing agentic AI is a first-class part of the job, not a side project.
Enterprise buyers. Mid-market and enterprise SaaS finance teams run deep security reviews. You will help win deals, not just pass audits.
What you will own
Security strategy and leadership
Define the multi-year security strategy, roadmap and budget, tied to company risk and growth plans
Run the risk register and make clear, documented risk-acceptance calls with leadership
Report security posture to the founders and board on a regular cadence
Hire and lead a small, high-leverage security team as the function grows
Product and application security
Own secure SDLC: threat modeling, design reviews, code scanning, dependency and secrets management
Partner with engineering so security is built in, not bolted on, without slowing shipping
Run the vulnerability management program, external pen tests and a bug bounty or disclosure program
Harden multi-tenant isolation, RBAC, SSO/SCIM and data masking (for example compensation data)
Cloud and infrastructure security
Own cloud security posture across our US and EU regions: IAM, network, encryption, key management, logging
Lead detection and response: SIEM, alerting, on-call, incident response playbooks and post-mortems
Secure the data pipeline behind 800+ connectors, including credentials and tokens for customer ERPs, CRMs and HRIS
AI security
Set the security model for our AI agents and MCP integrations: prompt injection, data exfiltration, permission boundaries, tool-use guardrails
Govern use of third-party model providers, including zero-data-retention and no-training commitments
Track and apply emerging AI security frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001)
Governance, risk and compliance
Own and mature SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR; lead audits end to end
Evaluate and drive new frameworks as the market demands (ISO 42001, ISO 27701, HIPAA or others)
Own policies, vendor risk management, access reviews and security awareness training
Run the Trust Center and security questionnaires, and join enterprise deals as the security voice
Corporate and IT security
Own endpoint, identity and SaaS security for employees across India and the US
Lead business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing
What you bring
10+ years in security, with 3+ years owning or leading the security program at a B2B SaaS company
Hands-on depth in cloud security (GCP or AWS), application security and incident response. You can still read code, review an architecture and lead a live incident
Has led SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits end to end, not just supported them
Has sat across from enterprise security teams in deal cycles and won their trust
Real AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in your own work, understand how LLMs and agents fail, and can secure systems built on them. This is a baseline for every role at Drivetrain, and a core requirement for this one
Comfortable making risk calls with incomplete information and explaining them in plain language to founders, engineers and customers
Builder mindset: you have set up a security function from an early stage, not only run a mature one
Nice to have
Security experience in fintech, financial systems or products that handle payroll and compensation data
SOC 1 (ICFR) audit experience
Hands-on work securing LLM applications, agents or MCP servers
Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP or CISM (useful, not required)
Experience with EU data residency and cross-border privacy requirements
Has worked across India and US teams and time zones
Your first 90 days
Days 1 to 30: Learn the product, architecture and data flows. Review the current control set, audit findings and risk register. Meet engineering, product, sales and customer success leads.
Days 31 to 60: Publish a security posture assessment and a prioritized 12-month roadmap with budget. Ship quick wins on the highest risks.
Days 61 to 90: Stand up the AI security model for agents and MCP. Own the next audit cycle and take over security reviews in live enterprise deals.
Why join
Own the entire security charter at a fast-growing AI company, with a clear path to CISO
Work on a hard, new problem: securing agentic AI on top of the most sensitive data a company has
Direct access to the founders and real influence on product, architecture and go-to-market
Join a team where AI is how everyone works, every day
Sounds exciting? Apply at careers@drivetrain.ai. It may just be the next best decision you’ve ever made!
